What Proximal sells

  • Data research and post-training infrastructure: Turns work records and outputs into tests of model abilities and targeted training data.
  • FrontierSWE v2: Tests extended technical work in implementation and performance. Tasks also cover science, visual reasoning and AI research.
  • Proximus: A testing system designed to keep agents working within a 20-hour task budget.
